0.2.2-0039
- New download is as wide as DSM's own dialogs with a text box (530 px), so long links wrap less; dialogs with a title have DSM's 3 px corners.
- Dialogs stay inside a narrow DSM window and fill the width on a phone.
- The buttons on Core updates are DSM's pill-shaped action buttons.
- Upgrading from 0.2.2-0038 needs no administrator approval.
